scenes.vo: Lesson twelve point zero. Mastery Starter.

scenes.sub: A bank keeps assets safe, lends, borrows and always has cash for what it owes. With DeFi you can run those four jobs yourself, with written policies, because there's nobody to call when something goes wrong.

scenes.title: Words you'll need
scenes.vo: Balance sheet, assets, liabilities and equity. Liquidity ladder, reserves tiered by how fast you can access them. Credit line, borrowing against assets under a policy. Runway, months your reserve can cover. Succession, how others recover your assets if you can't.
scenes.cap: Balance sheet, assets, liabilities and equity Liquidity ladder, reserves tiered by how fast you can access them Credit line, borrowing against assets under a policy Runway, months your reserve can cover Succession, how others recover your assets if you can't

scenes.title: The mastery ladder
scenes.vo: Beginner, Has a balance sheet and a basic custody split. Practitioner, Runs written custody, credit, ladder and lending policies. Master, Operates a complete bank with books, tax-ready records, succession and quarterly reviews.
